input.brief:
The 22 Oct miss was caused by the Q3 restatement backfill, not by the vendor incident or the new model. The backfill started at 00:58 and held an exclusive lock on stage_orders until 04:18. The nightly merge waited 2h14m for that lock. Everything else ran at normal speed: extract, merge execution, and marts all sat near their medians. Row volume was normal, and customer_ltv added only about 19 minutes. The Corvane incident ran 02:52–03:37, while the job was already stuck waiting, and it shows no slowdown in the steps. The backfill was approved for 13:00–17:00 but ran overnight. The implementer's note says "1:00", so a 1:00 versus 13:00 mix-up is plausible but unproven. Nobody told the job owner, and no lock-wait alert exists.

I'm quite confident in this diagnosis. I'd recommend adding the job owner as a mandatory reviewer, blocking overnight writes to its tables without sign-off, and alerting on lock waits over 15 minutes. Don't move tiers or pull customer_ltv, because the retention team depends on it. Keep the banner, because it stopped wrong numbers going into the flash pack. Don't discipline the implementer yet. The process gap is the bigger problem, and they're on leave and haven't been asked what happened.
